classification_rule: Only compact summaries, hashes, contracts, prose, and no-credential reproduction code are in the public baseline.
public_sanitized: Derived local counts and provider qualification hashes
Planning cost scenarios without account identifiers or raw provider bodies
local_private: machine/runtime custody and account-specific telemetry outside this package
secret_never_package: personal absolute paths, usernames, machine identifiers, process identifiers, and unrelated inventory
raw provider bodies unless separately sanitized and needed for a public claim
raw_provider_boundary: hashes and sanitized qualification summaries only; raw envelopes remain local-private
